vendor.zh: 字节跳动 · 火山引擎

access.zh: 火山方舟 API 与豆包 App；权重不开源。
access.en: Volcengine Ark API and the Doubao app; weights are not open.

generations.zh: 2026-11-19 上线 API：全双工、端到端实时音视频交互模型，原生融合音频、视频与文本；在 Seeduplex 基础上新增视频帧 / 图片输入（≤2 FPS）与火山搜图能力，可结合画面主动交互。
generations.en: API live on 2026-11-19: a full-duplex, end-to-end realtime audio-video interaction model that natively fuses audio, video and text; on top of Seeduplex it adds video-frame / image input (≤2 FPS) and Volcengine image search, enabling proactive on-screen interaction.

generations.zh: 2026-09-15 上线 Pro / Lite 0915：1024k 输入，Pro 256k 输出与 256k 思维链；Lite 原生统一文本、视觉与音频理解（火山方舟发布公告）。
generations.en: Pro / Lite 0915 launched on 2026-09-15: 1024k input; Pro supports 256k output and 256k thinking; Lite natively unifies text, vision and audio understanding (Volcengine Ark announcement).

generations.zh: 2026-11 Seed-Evolving 版本更新：官方定位为 Coding & Agent 持续升级模型，1024k 上下文 / 256k 输出（火山方舟模型广场）。
generations.en: November 2026 Seed-Evolving update: officially positioned as a continuously upgraded Coding & Agent model, 1024k context / 256k output (Volcengine Ark model marketplace).

generations.zh: 当前代：模型广场列 doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260628（256k 上下文 / 256k 输出）与 2.1-turbo；另有 doubao-seed-evolving（1024k / 256k，Coding & Agent 持续升级定位）。
generations.en: Current line: the model marketplace lists doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260628 (256k context / 256k output) and 2.1-turbo; plus doubao-seed-evolving (1024k / 256k, pitched as a continuously upgraded Coding & Agent model).

generations.zh: 上一代：2.0-pro/lite/mini（256k 上下文 / 128k 输出；lite 为官方口径「首款全模态理解模型」）；260215 档标注「即将下线」——闭源代次更替的直接证据。
generations.en: Previous line: 2.0-pro/lite/mini (256k context / 128k output; lite billed by the vendor as its "first omni-modal understanding model"); the 260215 snapshots are marked "soon to be retired" — direct evidence of closed-line churn.

v.zh: 2.1-pro-260915 / 2.1-lite-260915：1024k 输入；2.1-pro 最大输出 256k、最大思维链 256k（火山方舟模型详情）
v.en: 2.1-pro-260915 / 2.1-lite-260915: 1024k input; 2.1-pro supports 256k max output and 256k max thinking (Volcengine Ark model detail)

v.zh: 按档位与用量计费，本站不抄具体数字；以官方模型页或发布页的定价表为准。
v.en: Billed by tier and usage; this site does not copy numbers — see the official pricing table.

v.zh: 文本、图片、视频输入；2.1-lite 原生支持文本 / 视觉 / 音频统一理解（火山发布公告）
v.en: Text, image and video input; 2.1-lite natively unifies text, vision and audio understanding (Volcengine release announcement)

v.zh: 0915 版本强化 Agent 长程执行、多模态 Coding 与多模态理解；Seed-Evolving 2026-11 更新集中在多步任务规划、结果验收、工具调用与事实一致性，时延与单次成本下降（火山公告）
v.en: The 0915 release strengthens long-horizon agent execution, multimodal coding and multimodal understanding; the November Seed-Evolving update focuses on multi-step planning, result acceptance, tool use and factual consistency, with lower latency and cost per call (Volcengine announcement)

v.zh: Seedream 5.5 图像模型与 Seedance 2.5 Flash 视频模型于 2026-11-18 上线；Seedance 2.5 Flash 支持最长 30s、480P/720P、最多 10 图 + 5 视频 + 5 音频参考（火山模型广场）
v.en: Seedream 5.5 (image) and Seedance 2.5 Flash (video) went live on 2026-11-18; Seedance 2.5 Flash supports up to 30s, 480P/720P, and up to 10 images + 5 videos + 5 audio references (Volcengine model marketplace)

v.zh: 豆包实时音视频模型 1.0（Doubao-Seed-Realtime 1.0）于 2026-11-19 上线 API：全双工、端到端，原生融合音频、视频与文本；支持把摄像头 / 屏幕画面以不超过 2 FPS 推给服务端，结合画面理解指代与场景变化（火山引擎豆包语音产品页 / Android SDK 文档）。
v.en: Doubao-Seed-Realtime 1.0 went live in the API on 2026-11-19: full-duplex, end-to-end, natively fusing audio, video and text; clients can push camera / screen frames at up to 2 FPS so the model can resolve references and track scene changes (Volcengine Doubao Voice product page / Android SDK docs).

positioning.zh: 国产闭源主力：对话产品「豆包」与 API「Doubao-Seed」同族两条线；服务在网信办备案（Beijing-YunQue-20230821，豆包大模型=云雀更名，官方备案公示页确认）。代次更替快，卡片上标了资料时间和复核周期。
positioning.en: The domestic closed flagship: the Doubao consumer app and the Doubao-Seed API are two lines of one family; the service is CAC-filed (Beijing-YunQue-20230821 — Doubao LLM is the renamed YunQue, confirmed on the official filing-disclosure page). Generations churn fast, so the card carries a check date and review interval.

onSite.zh: 权重不开源，这里无量化对比；对话产品三要素轻档案在 AI 工具站（对话问答区）。
onSite.en: No open weights, no quantisation coverage; the three-essentials light entry for the app lives on the tools site (chat section).
